chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Transcription work in New York
summary: Chick's band made radio transcriptions that stopped without explanation as hotels piped in softer music.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: -- Chick's band you did a lot of transcription work --

Yeah. We did that in New York. I just ran across some articles on some of the things that we had done, you know. We used to do a lot of stuff like that. And all of sudden, they cut that out. We didn't do too much of that.

I don't know why. I guess -- Really, they didn't give a reason why they dropped it, you know, (inaudible) used to do a lot of transcriptions. (inaudible). Then all of a sudden we didn't get any more. I guess they brought in other bands to do it -- do that hotel. You know, they piped that stuff in the hotel and things. And I guess they did about as
